1| package notify
2| 
3| import "time"
4| 
5| // retryPlan owns the per-receiver retry schedule. Plans are built
6| // from the receiver's declared policy at profile load and never
7| // consult the clock themselves: the drain loop asks for the next
8| // attempt time and the plan answers from its precomputed ladder,
9| // which keeps retry behaviour reproducible in replay tests.
10| type retryPlan struct {
11| 	ladder  []time.Duration
12| 	attempt int
13| 	ceiling time.Duration
14| }
15| 
16| // next returns the delay before the following attempt, or false once
17| // the ladder is exhausted. Exhaustion is terminal by design: a
18| // receiver that wants more attempts declares a longer ladder in its
19| // policy instead of the notifier inventing retries it was never
20| // asked to make.
21| func (r *retryPlan) next() (time.Duration, bool) {
22| 	if r.attempt >= len(r.ladder) {
23| 		return 0, false
24| 	}
25| 	d := r.ladder[r.attempt]
26| 	if d > r.ceiling {
27| 		d = r.ceiling
28| 	}
29| 	r.attempt++
30| 	return d, true
31| }
